html:
British Somaliland was a British protectorate on the Gulf of Aden coast of northern Somalia, set up by treaties with Somali clans from 1884 to 1886 and lasting until 1960.

Britain wanted it mainly to feed its base at Aden across the water with meat. It ruled lightly through clan elders from Berbera and later Hargeisa, and spent years fighting the Dervish state of Mohammed Abdullah Hassan, defeated only in 1920.

It became independent on 26 June 1960 and joined former Italian Somaliland five days later as the Somali Republic. Its separate past was the basis for the breakaway of Somaliland in 1991.
sum: British Somaliland was a British protectorate on the Gulf of Aden coast of northern Somalia, set up by treaties with Somali clans from 1884 to 1886 and lasting until 1960.
